key.name: accounts
key.description: JSON list of account profiles containing only id, name and authPath. Tokens are read from their files.

key.name: panel-account-id
key.description: The profile ID whose usage appears in the top bar.

key.name: default-account-name
key.description: A display name for the default Codex CLI account. Empty uses Codex CLI.

key.name: update-interval-seconds
key.description: Number of seconds between usage refreshes.

key.name: display-mode
key.description: Choose whether the extension shows remaining quota or consumed quota.

key.name: reset-credit-expiry-mode
key.description: Show time left until reset credits expire or their local expiry date and time.
